title: 第17章 赤翎战林间 斜阳归庇护第18章 夜居平疲损 寻草解灼伤
lines: 阳光穿透林间薄雾，将溪边的草木镀上一层暖金，空气中还残留着烤肉的香气与淡淡的血气，却挡不住两人周身骤然攀升的灵气波动。
罗止正缓缓松开紧握的拳头，指尖划过周身流转的灵气，凡级二阶初期的力量在四肢百骸流淌。原本胸口、肩头的伤口已然结痂脱落，只留下浅浅的印子，就连发麻的虎口也彻底恢复，握枪时愈发沉稳有力。他低头看向溪边平整铺开的青纹巨松鼠兽皮，厚实的绒毛蓬松柔软，青纹依旧鲜亮，指尖轻抚，能清晰感受到其中残存的淡淡灵气，用来做毯子再合适不过。
李紫云还在试着适应暴涨的力量，她抬手挽弓，铁木弓在手中宛若轻物，随意一拉便拉至满盈，弓弦颤动间，力道比之前强了不止一倍。她松开弓弦，箭矢破空而出，精准射中远处的树干，箭身深深没入其中，看得她眉眼弯弯，满心都是欢喜。
李紫云眉眼亮晶晶的，带着难掩的雀跃，快步跑到罗止正身边：“太好了，以后再遇到凶兽，我也能更快更准地射箭了！”
罗止正看着她雀跃的模样，嘴角笑意温和，弯腰将兽皮卷起捆好，语气沉稳叮嘱：“突破境界是好事，但也不能掉以轻心，翠影高台远比我们想象的更大，藏着的凶险未必只有青纹巨松鼠一种。”
他随手摘下几片宽大树叶，将剩下的灵鼠肉仔细包好，伸手递到李紫云面前。
罗止正眼神柔和，轻声说道：“剩下的灵肉先放进储物袋，灵气很足，不能浪费。”
李紫云双手接过肉包，顺势直接放进储物袋，乖巧点头应道：“嗯，我知道了。”
李紫云收敛笑意，一脸郑重握紧铁木弓，眼神坚定：“我们接下来还要继续探查高台吗？”
罗止正抬眼望向溪流上游，目光深邃，语气笃定：“嗯，这条小溪灵气浓郁，顺着它往上走，说不定能找到水源源头，也能摸清翠影高台更深处的地形，再看看能不能找到更多有用的物资。”
两人简单收拾好现场，熄灭篝火残留的火星，便沿着清澈的小溪继续向上前行。突破到凡级二阶初期后，两人的感官愈发敏锐，林间细微的风声、虫蚁爬动的声响都清晰入耳，脚步也变得愈发轻盈，行走在交错的古木根系上，平稳又迅捷。
越往高台深处走，古木愈发粗壮参天，树冠遮天蔽日，林间光线渐渐变暗，空气中的灵气浓度也节节攀升，草木长得愈发繁茂，甚至有不少不知名的奇花异草点缀其间，叶片晶莹，花瓣剔透，一看便蕴含着灵气。
罗止正在前方开路，紧握盘根铁木枪，时刻警惕四周，语气平静提醒：“小心脚下，别乱碰不知名的草木，免得有毒刺。”
李紫云走在罗止正身侧，目光好奇打量四周，突破境界后她感知大幅提升，能清晰察觉周遭凶兽气息，一路只遇到几只温顺的一阶小灵兽，并无威胁。
行不多时，头顶树冠忽然传来一阵急促的振翅声，尖锐又密集，打破了林间的宁静。
罗止正脚步一顿，立刻抬枪戒备，沉声低喝：“上方有灵兽！”
李紫云心头一紧，瞬间挽弓搭箭，仰头望去，只见浓密枝叶间，一道火红身影正低空盘旋，尖喙频频啄食着树间虫豸与浆果，显然是在此处觅食。
那飞鸟翼展近三尺，通体覆着鲜亮赤红翎羽，翅尖与尾羽镶着耀眼金纹，头顶一簇火苗状羽冠挺立，喙爪锋利如琥珀，一双瞳仁橙红如燃火。它周身萦绕着灼热火灵气，羽毛自带高温火焰，近身便会被灼烧，同时速度快得惊人，在空中辗转腾挪如履平地，短距间更是能骤然突进，极难捕捉踪迹。
这是赤翎火雀，凡级二阶初期飞行灵兽。
赤翎火雀察觉到两人气息，觅食动作骤然一顿，火红瞳仁瞬间变得锐利。它猛地振翅升空，在两人头顶盘旋一圈，发出尖锐啼鸣，径直将闯入领地的二人视作威胁。
罗止正神色凝重，低声提醒：“是凡级二阶初期的飞行灵兽，速度极快，小心应对。”
李紫云弓身微侧，箭矢直指高空，眼神专注：“飞行灵兽我来应对，你帮我牵制它的动向。”
话音未落，赤翎火雀尖啸一声，双翼剧烈震颤，数片燃着明火的翎羽骤然脱离羽翼，带着灼热劲风，密密麻麻朝着两人爆射而来。
这正是炎羽飞射。
罗止正眼神一厉，立刻横枪挡在李紫云身前，手腕发力转动枪身，将袭来的火羽尽数格挡，可仍有漏网的火羽擦过他的小臂，瞬间燎起一片灼红，火辣辣的痛感蔓延开来。他闷哼一声，却依旧稳稳持枪，眉头紧紧蹙起。
赤翎火雀本就羽毛带火，近身触碰便有灼烧之感，这便是它的炎羽护体。
李紫云抓住空隙，当即拉弓射箭，箭矢带着破空声直取火雀身躯。
不等箭矢近身，赤翎火雀双翼狂扇，一道熊熊燃烧的火焰风墙骤然挡在身前，将射来的箭矢瞬间焚烧阻隔。
这正是火羽障。
火焰热浪扑面而至，试图靠近的人都会被灼伤、速度大减。紧接着，它全身裹起炽烈火焰，身形化作一道赤红流光，笔直俯冲而下，尖喙带着焚灼之力直刺李紫云。
这正是赤焰冲啄。
李紫云急忙侧身翻滚躲闪，肩头依旧被火焰余波扫中，衣衫灼焦，皮肤泛起火辣辣的疼，脚步一个踉跄。
赤翎火雀一击之后并不纠缠，周身骤然浮现数道火焰残像，身形在残影间连续变向，极速拉开距离，闪避得无影无踪。
这正是焚空掠影。
赤翎火雀借着迅炎之速在高空盘旋，速度远超寻常二阶灵兽，一时之间两人竟难以锁定。
它再次俯冲而来，施展出赤焰冲啄，罗止正挺枪直刺，不料枪尖擦到火雀羽翼，反被炎羽护体的火焰灼得枪杆发烫，手指一阵刺痛。
李紫云抓住空隙，一箭疾射而出，火雀却凭借焚空掠影轻松闪避，反手就是一轮炎羽飞射。几片火羽擦过李紫云的手臂，留下几道浅浅灼痕，她闷哼一声，却依旧握弓稳固。
罗止正看在眼里，心头一紧，沉声喝道：“它速度虽快，但转向必有间隙！我来正面牵制，你瞄准它的羽冠！”
content_en:
The sun penetrated the mist in the forest, coating the grass and trees by the stream with a layer of warm gold. The aroma of barbecue and a touch of blood still lingered in the air, but it could not stop the sudden rise in spiritual energy fluctuations around the two of them.
Luo Zhizheng slowly loosened his clenched fists, his fingertips traced the spiritual energy flowing around his body, and the power of the early second-level mortal level flowed through his limbs and bones. The original wounds on his chest and shoulders have scabbed off, leaving only shallow marks. Even the numbness in the tiger's mouth has completely recovered, and he has become more steady and powerful when holding the gun. He looked down at the giant squirrel skin with blue stripes spread flat by the stream. The thick fur was fluffy and soft, and the blue stripes were still bright. When he touched it with his fingertips, he could clearly feel the faint aura remaining in it. It was perfect for making a blanket.
Li Ziyun was still trying to adapt to the surge in power. She raised her hand to draw the bow. The ironwood bow was like a light object in her hand. She pulled it to fullness with a casual pull. As the bow string trembled, the strength was more than twice as strong as before. She loosened the bowstring, and the arrow shot out of the air, accurately hitting the tree trunk in the distance. The arrow sank deeply into it, making her eyebrows curl and her heart filled with joy.
Li Ziyun's eyebrows were bright and she couldn't hide her excitement, and she quickly ran to Luo Zhizheng: "Great, I will be able to shoot arrows faster and more accurately when I encounter ferocious beasts in the future!"
Luo Zhizheng looked at her excited expression, with a gentle smile on his lips. He bent down to roll up the animal skin and tied it up, and warned in a calm tone: "It is a good thing to break through the realm, but we should not take it lightly. The Cuiying Platform is far bigger than we imagined, and the hidden dangers may not only be the blue-striped giant squirrel."
He picked off a few broad leaves, carefully wrapped the remaining spirit rat meat, and handed it to Li Ziyun.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes were soft and he said softly: "Put the remaining spiritual flesh into the storage bag first. The spiritual energy is abundant and cannot be wasted."
Li Ziyun took the meat bun with both hands and put it directly into the storage bag. He nodded obediently and said, "Yes, I understand."
Li Ziyun suppressed his smile and solemnly grasped the Ironwood Bow with a firm look in his eyes: "Are we still going to continue to explore the high platform?"
Luo Zhizheng raised his eyes to look upstream of the stream, his eyes were deep and his tone was firm: "Well, this stream is full of spiritual energy. If you go up it, you might be able to find the source of the water source, and you can also understand the terrain deeper in Cuiying Plateau, and then see if you can find more useful supplies."
The two simply cleaned up the scene, extinguished the remaining sparks of the campfire, and continued up the clear stream. After breaking through to the early stage of the second mortal level, the two people's senses became more and more acute. The subtle sounds of wind in the forest and the crawling sounds of insects and ants were clearly heard. Their footsteps became lighter and lighter, walking on the intertwined roots of ancient trees, smoothly and quickly.
As we go deeper into the platform, the ancient trees become thicker and towering. The canopy blocks the sky and the sun. The light in the forest gradually dims. The concentration of spiritual energy in the air also increases. The grass and trees grow more luxuriantly. There are even many unknown exotic flowers and plants dotted among them. The leaves are crystal clear and the petals are clear. They contain spiritual energy at a glance.
Luo Zhi was clearing the way ahead, holding the coiled iron gun tightly, always alert to the surroundings, and reminded in a calm tone: "Be careful where you step, don't touch unknown vegetation, lest there be poisonous stings."
Li Ziyun walked beside Luo Zhizheng, looking around curiously. After breaking through the realm, her perception greatly improved, and she could clearly detect the aura of vicious beasts around her. She only encountered a few docile first-order small spirit beasts along the way, and there was no threat.
Not long after walking, a rapid flapping of wings suddenly came from the canopy of trees overhead. It was sharp and dense, breaking the tranquility of the forest.
Luo Zhizheng paused, immediately raised his gun on guard, and shouted in a deep voice: "There are spiritual beasts above!"
Li Ziyun's heart tightened, and he instantly drew his bow and nocked an arrow. Looking up, he saw a fiery red figure hovering low among the dense branches and leaves, with its sharp beak frequently pecking at insects and berries in the trees, apparently looking for food here.
The bird's wingspan was nearly three feet, and its entire body was covered with bright red feathers. Its wingtips and tail feathers were inlaid with dazzling golden patterns. A cluster of flame-like feathers stood upright on its head, its beak and claws were as sharp as amber, and its pupils were as orange as burning fire. It is surrounded by a scorching fire aura, and its feathers carry high-temperature flames that will be burned if you get close. At the same time, it is incredibly fast, tossing and turning in the air as if it were walking on the ground, and it can suddenly rush forward in a short distance, making it extremely difficult to catch traces.
This is the red-feathered fire sparrow, a flying spiritual beast in the early stage of the second-level mortal level.
The red-feathered fire sparrow noticed the auras of the two of them, and suddenly paused in its foraging movements. Its fiery red pupils instantly became sharp. It suddenly flapped its wings and flew into the air, hovering above the two of them, emitting a sharp cry, directly treating the two who broke into the territory as a threat.
Luo Zhizheng looked solemn and reminded in a low voice: "It is a flying spirit beast in the early stage of the second level of mortal level. It is extremely fast, so be careful when dealing with it."
Li Ziyun bowed slightly to the side, pointing the arrow straight into the sky, his eyes focused: "I will deal with the flying spirit beast, you help me contain its movements."
Before he finished speaking, the red-feathered fire sparrow screamed, its wings trembled violently, and several feathers burning with open flames suddenly separated from the wings, and with scorching strong wind, they densely shot toward the two of them.
This is Yanyu Feishe.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes were sharp, and he immediately blocked the gun in front of Li Ziyun. He turned the gun with his wrist and blocked all the incoming fire feathers. However, there were still fire feathers that escaped the net and brushed against his forearm. It instantly turned red and the burning pain spread. He groaned, but still held the gun steadily, frowning tightly.
The red-feathered fire sparrow's feathers are originally filled with fire, and it will feel burning when touched up close. This is its flaming feather body protection.
Li Ziyun seized the gap, immediately drew the bow and shot an arrow, and the arrow hit the fire bird's body with a sound of breaking through the air.
Before the arrow could get close, the red-feathered fire sparrow flapped its wings wildly, and a blazing flame wind wall suddenly blocked in front of it, burning and blocking the incoming arrow in an instant.
This is the Fire Feather Barrier.
The heat wave of flames hits you, and anyone who tries to get close will be burned and their speed will be greatly reduced. Immediately afterwards, its whole body was wrapped in blazing flames, its body turned into a stream of red light, and it swooped down, its sharp beak stabbing Li Ziyun with burning power.
This is exactly what Red Flame is attacking.
Li Ziyun hurriedly rolled sideways to dodge, but his shoulders were still swept away by the aftermath of the flames. His clothes were scorched, his skin felt burning pain, and he staggered.
The Red-feathered Fire Sparrow did not get entangled after the attack. Several afterimages of flames suddenly appeared around its body. Its figure continuously changed directions among the afterimages, widening the distance at an extremely fast speed, and dodging without a trace.
This is exactly what happened in the sky.
The red-feathered fire sparrow hovered high in the sky with its rapid fire speed, far exceeding the speed of ordinary second-level spiritual beasts. For a moment, it was difficult for the two to lock onto each other.
It swooped down again, using red flames to peck at him. Luo Zhi was thrusting forward with his spear, but unexpectedly the tip of the spear scraped against the fire bird's wings. Instead, the flames from the flames' protective body scorched the barrel of the spear, causing his fingers to sting.
Li Ziyun seized the gap and shot out an arrow quickly, but the fire bird easily dodged it with the help of the sky-burning shadow, and fired a round of flame feathers with his backhand. A few fire feathers brushed against Li Ziyun's arm, leaving a few shallow burn marks. She groaned, but still held the bow firmly.
Luo Zhizheng saw this, his heart tightened, and he shouted in a deep voice: "Although it is fast, there must be a gap in its turn! I will restrain it from the front, and you aim at its crest!"
title_en: Chapter 17: Red Ling fights in the forest, the setting sun returns to shelter Chapter 18: Ye Juping is tired, looking for grass to relieve his burns
